_about: One world, asked the same questions through both transports - the PowerShell
stub (scripts/rehearse-sentinel-stub.ps1, which the cron tools really run
against) and the Node fetch shim (installFetchShim in scripts/rehearse-world.mjs,
which the Node tools really run against). The router between them is one
interpreter, so the property under rehearsal is the TRANSPORT: the same facts
must arrive at both callers, including the two shapes the real API produces and
the scripts' own wraps exist to survive - a one-element array (PowerShell
unrolls it to a single object, a tidy array would rehearse a kinder GitHub) and
none at all. Driven by scripts/rehearse-transports.mjs; see its header for why
an untested parity claim is the exact defect class this repo keeps meeting.
One case (artifact-zip) is not a comparison of two answers but of what each side
CAN do: an artifact is bytes, only the Node transport has a reader for it (the
recovery pass, whose own unzipEntry the driver uses), and the PowerShell transport
must REFUSE the bytes rather than answer an empty 200 - a successful download of
nothing is a rehearsal of the wrong thing. The case declares that, because agreeing
about a route one side cannot carry would be the kinder-GitHub mistake this file's

comments.body: recovered PASS, recorded the day before promotion day

cases.name: issue-get
cases.about: An object response, the ordinary case.

cases.name: comments-window-many
cases.about: An array with more than one element, oldest first, instants verbatim.

cases.name: comments-window-one
cases.about: The unrolling hazard: one element, which PowerShell hands over as a single object with no .Count.

cases.name: comments-window-none
cases.about: The other unrolling hazard: an empty array, which PowerShell hands over as $null.

cases.name: workflow-runs
cases.about: A list nested inside an object, newest first.

cases.name: post-refused
cases.about: A write the world refuses for THIS token - the missing-scope 403, details and all.
cases.body: {"body":"a record the workflow could not file"}

cases.name: post-accepted
cases.about: A write the world accepts: the same request, a token that may.

cases.name: unrouted
cases.about: A route the world does not describe: both transports must FAIL here, never reach the network.

cases.name: artifact-zip
cases.about: The recovery pass's download: BYTES. Node must hand back the world's log read out of the zip with the pass's own reader; PowerShell, which has no zip reader and no tool here that asks for one, must refuse with the reason the case names. An empty 200 would rehearse a download of nothing.

cases.name: raw-file
cases.about: A raw.githubusercontent.com file, which the verifiers read with Invoke-WebRequest.
